\subsection*{Turing Machine --- Build --- Contract --- Embed: Results}

\begin{definition}[Embedding a machine contract]
\lean{Turing.Contract.embed}
\label{Turing.Contract.embed}
\leanok
\uses{Turing.Cfg.select, Turing.Contract, Turing.MultiTapeTM, Turing.MultiTapeTM.runFrom, Turing.embedEmitCfg, Turing.embedEmitCfg_select, Turing.embedEmitCfg_selected_pos, Turing.embedEmitTM, Turing.embedEmitTM_frame, Turing.embedEmitTM_runFrom}
Let a machine with $m$ work tapes be embedded into a machine with $k$ work tapes by an
injection of tape indices, and let a contract describe its computation from an entry
state to a prescribed set of exit states. The induced contract for the embedded machine
uses the restriction of each starting configuration to the embedded tapes for its
precondition and running time, embeds the original endpoint into the larger
configuration, and extends the head-position bounds by keeping each unused tape's head
at its starting position.
\end{definition}

\begin{theorem}[Embedding a trajectory property]
\lean{Turing.Contract.Traj.embed}
\label{Turing.Contract.Traj.embed}
\leanok
\uses{Turing.Cfg, Turing.Cfg.select, Turing.Contract, Turing.Contract.Traj, Turing.Contract.embed, Turing.MultiTapeTM, Turing.MultiTapeTM.runFrom, Turing.embedEmitCfg, Turing.embedEmitCfg_select, Turing.embedEmitCfg_selected_pos, Turing.embedEmitCfg_unselected, Turing.embedEmitTM_runFrom}
\difficulty{4}
Let $C$ be a contract for a machine with $m$ work tapes, and embed those tapes into a
machine with $k$ work tapes by an injection of tape indices. If a predicate $R$ holds
throughout every eligible trajectory of $C$, then throughout every eligible trajectory
of the induced embedded contract, $R$ holds for the selected configuration and the
selected head positions; moreover, each unselected head position equals its value in the
starting configuration.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Positivity under tape embedding]
\lean{Turing.Contract.embed_positive}
\label{Turing.Contract.embed_positive}
\leanok
\uses{Turing.Contract, Turing.Contract.Positive, Turing.Contract.embed, Turing.MultiTapeTM}
\difficulty{1}
Let $m,k$ be natural numbers, let $\sigma$ inject the $m$ work-tape indices into the $k$
work-tape indices, and let $C$ be a contract for an $m$-tape machine. If $C$ has
strictly positive assigned time for every datum and every starting configuration in its
entry state satisfying its precondition, then the contract induced by embedding $C$ into
the $k$-tape machine also has strictly positive assigned time for every datum and every
eligible starting configuration.
\end{theorem}
